ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity cream/white pixels across central lobe surfaces versus 15% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the perimeter and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous off-white/cream regions across both lobes; thick black border (approx. 20-60 pixels wide) along the trailing edge; vertical black wedge at the median junction; distinct 'S' or 'figure-8' shaped dark pixel cluster in the lower-left quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 40 degrees; deep vertical penetration relative to the horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing margin; 3-8 pixel amplitude variations (peaks/valleys) observed; higher irregularity and jaggedness detected toward both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch toward the lobe apices.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, sparse vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe interior; low contrast compared to primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular morphological protrusion on the left lobe apex featuring reddish-brown and black pixel clusters; right lobe apex displays an irregular, non-smooth blunted termination.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique black 'S-shaped' pigmentation mark located at the interior lower-left fluke region, distinct from the perimeter banding.
